WC04 Camera 0.3.2 USB EXPERIMENTAL - PRIVATE LOCAL TEST ONLY

Copy apps/wc04-camera-experimental to the SD card's apps directory.
Replace the existing experimental folder's contents with this version; keep the
baseline apps/wc04-camera folder and earlier ZIPs. Confirm 0.3.2 in HBC.
This build fixes compact IOS vendor/product byte order and improves rejection
logs. Other-camera operation is still unverified; later compatibility limits
may remain. Existing photographs/videos need not be deleted.
Requires Wii Remote, HBC under IOS58, writable FAT SD for saving.

Experimental subset: single-configuration UVC 1.0 cameras offering progressive
MJPEG at 320x240 or 640x480, isochronous IN with bInterval=1, advertised
frame buffer at most 614400 bytes and a supported descriptor default interval.
WC04 is preferred when connected. Otherwise the first supported interface wins.
Use one camera; change the menu size explicitly if that size is unsupported.
No actual speed is inferred from the USB version. Non-WC04 cameras, full-speed
operation, hubs and vWii are unverified. No guarantee of frame rate or compatibility.
Newer UVC 1.1/1.5 controls, bulk, YUYV, interlaced modes, proprietary protocols,
audio, multiple configurations and automatic reconnect are unsupported.
Camera check reads descriptors only; supported descriptors do not prove video.
The default frame interval is used; there is no guessed frame rate or fallback.
No configuration changes, device firmware, custom IOS or system modifications.
Insert SD before launch. The app never installs/reloads IOS or writes NAND.

Menu: A opens live view; 1 changes resolution; 2 checks the camera.
+ switches Photo / Video. Left/right selects timer Off / 3 / 5 / 10 seconds.
Photo: A captures or starts countdown; B cancels countdown, otherwise menu.
Review: A returns to live, B returns to menu.
Video: A starts, A or B stops and saves. Silent sampled MJPEG AVI only.
HOME exits, stopping camera and finalizing a video first.
No signal: A retries after timeout/failure; B returns to menu.

Photos: sd:/DCIM/100WC04/WC04####.JPG
Video: sd:/wc04-camera/videos/VID####.AVI
Log: sd:/wc04-camera/session.log (appended)
Existing files are never overwritten. Failed partial output from the current
attempt is removed best-effort; failed media may prevent cleanup. Power loss can leave a partial AVI. 9999 names per type.

Video stops at 60 seconds, 128 MiB, or 3600 accepted frames. There is no promised
frame rate or audio. SD/CPU load may skip frames. Saved duration follows elapsed
time, but sampled frames play evenly, so motion may be jerky. Computer playback
was host-tested with FFmpeg; Photo Channel video playback is not promised.

No decoded frame for 1 second shows full SMPTE bars; 10 seconds stops the stream.
Timer or pending shutter is canceled by lost signal. If USB drain waits, unplug the camera.
A wedged IOS or SD operation can still block; do not remove SD while saving.

This experiment is host-tested and compiled, NOT verified on physical Wii.
The old WC04 0.1.3 still-photo evidence does not certify this build or other devices.
Physical testing is deferred. Keep the baseline ZIP for later comparison.

https://www.vecteezy.com/vector-art/5252064-webcam-device-technology

This binary embeds glyph bitmaps made from locally installed Rodin NTLG Pro DB.
Public redistribution rights are NOT established. This package is only for
Jaxi's private local test. The full OTF is not bundled. See licenses/UI-font.txt.
